about_the_game:
Stick Syndicate is a Real Time Strategy Roguelike all about GANG VIOLENCE.

🔫 Recruit gang members from a pool of 100+ characters, all with unique effects. Choose carefully, and place your goons on the grid for perfect cooperation.

🩸 Beware, your rivals are out for blood and their goons will be coming for you. Think fast and crush their boss to conquer their territory.

🤝 Combine your strength with neighboring gangs to take on the city, trade for powerful weapons and equipment, or dominate your rivals for amazing risk and rewards.

The streets are watching. Prove you’re the baddest boss in town, or get buried trying.

content_descriptors.notes:
Mature Content Description:

This game contains stylized cartoon violence and comedic references to criminal activity. Players manage a fictional gang and encounter exaggerated characters such as a "weed dealer," "meth head," as well characters with various stylized weapons (guns, knives, etc). 

All violence is non-graphic, using stick figure animations with no blood or gore. Mild language such as "damn" and "hell" appears occasionally. The game does not depict sexual content, realistic drug use, or graphic violence.

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 22.04, Ubuntu 24.04
  • Processor: x64 architecture with SSE2 instruction set support
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: OpenGL 3.2+, Vulkan capable GPUs
  • Storage: 500 MB available space

short_description: In this roguelike RTS, build up an unstoppable team, participate in thrilling turf wars, and expand your territory. Fight, trade, or ally with rivaling gangs in your quest to conquer the streets. Only one criminal empire can rule over Stick City, will it be yours?
